name: claude-design
title: Claude Design MCP server
summary: Create, edit and sync designs and interactive prototypes without leaving the terminal. Work moves both ways: pull an existing design system in with /design-sync, or hand a design off to be implemented as code.

apps: Claude Code - /design-sync and /design-login are Claude Code commands; other agents cannot authenticate to this server
A paid Anthropic plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise). Claude Design is in beta
One-time sign-in: run /design-login in Claude Code after adding the server

setup:
Anthropic documents this server at USER scope, not project scope:

    claude mcp add --scope user --transport http claude-design https://api.anthropic.com/v1/design/mcp

Prefer that command. Claude Design is tied to your own Anthropic account and paid plan, so a project-scoped entry in a committed .mcp.json would hand every teammate a server they may not be entitled to use - and would still fail until each of them ran /design-login.

Then, in Claude Code:

    /design-login    authenticate the connection, once
    /design-sync     pull the project's design system in, so generated designs start from existing components

If the connection fails, check the plan first: on a plan without Claude Design the server is reachable but returns nothing usable.
